utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you for calling member services, this call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. My name is Jordan, how can I help you today?

utterances.speaker: member
utterances.text: Hi, I want to check if my plan is still active this month.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Can you read me your member identification number please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, it shows active coverage effective this year.

utterances.speaker: member
utterances.text: Great, that's all I needed, thank you.
